astra.title: Your [[AI System Administrator]]
astra.subtitle: ASTRA watches every device, understands issues in plain English, gathers evidence, and heals problems automatically — with human-in-the-loop control at every tier that matters.

loopHead.title: An agentic workflow, not a black box
loopHead.subtitle: Each step is a tool the model calls — evidence before action, verification after.

capsHead.title: Everything ASTRA does out of the box
capsHead.subtitle: A complete AI operations platform for your Windows fleet.

features.title: Asset Inventory
features.desc: A live, auto-discovered registry of every device, spec, app and license across your fleet.

features.title: Live Telemetry
features.desc: CPU, RAM, disk, event logs, apps, services and Windows updates streamed in real time.

features.title: AI Cognitive Engine
features.desc: An agentic reasoning loop that recognizes intent, searches knowledge and scores confidence.

features.title: Self-Healing
features.desc: Allowlisted, tiered remediations that fix issues automatically — or with approval.

features.title: Patch Management
features.desc: Push Windows Updates to any device — or the whole fleet — from the admin panel and watch rollout live.

features.title: Conversational AI
features.desc: Users describe problems in plain language; ASTRA investigates and resolves.

features.title: Approval Tiers
features.desc: Automatic, approval-required and admin-only — enforced in code, not just prompts.

features.title: Reporting
features.desc: Fleet health, resolution and compliance reports ready for stakeholders.

features.title: Notifications
features.desc: Proactive alerts the moment something needs a human decision.

features.title: Full Audit Trail
features.desc: Every mutation and agent command is logged, attributable and reviewable.

features.title: Secure Offboarding
features.desc: When someone leaves, lock down their account and force them out of their session in one click — before data can walk out.

features.title: Compliance & Security Posture
features.desc: A live compliance dashboard scores your fleet's security posture and flags the devices that fall short.

features.title: Restricted Software Detection
features.desc: Spot unapproved or risky applications across every device, so shadow IT surfaces before it becomes an incident.

features.title: Fleet Correlation & Mass Remediation
features.desc: ASTRA links the same fault across many devices, then fixes the whole affected group in one click instead of one by one.

features.title: Helpdesk Integration
features.desc: Connect Freshservice and let ASTRA raise a ticket for what it can't fix itself — with the device's evidence attached, and only after the user agrees.

features.title: Self-Learning Knowledge Base
features.desc: Every confirmed fix teaches the knowledge base. ASTRA publishes what repeatedly works, drops advice whose success rate falls, and keeps the words users actually type.

features.title: Asset Assignment & Acknowledgement
features.desc: Hand a laptop to an employee and ASTRA emails them to confirm receipt — sent from your own verified domain, with the signed acknowledgement kept on the asset record.

inventory.title: Know every device, automatically
inventory.desc: The moment an agent enrolls, ASTRA builds a live inventory — hardware specs, installed apps, services, licenses and health. No spreadsheets, no manual audits, always current.
bullets: Search and filter across the fleet

telemetry.title: Real-time evidence from every endpoint
telemetry.desc: A lightweight Windows agent streams CPU, memory, disk, event logs, running apps, services and Windows Update status back to the platform — the raw evidence ASTRA reasons over.

healingHead.title: Fixes that respect human control
healingHead.subtitle: ASTRA never runs a higher-tier action without the right approval — enforced in the backend, never only in the prompt.

patch.title: Push Windows Updates [[from the admin panel]]
patch.desc: Spot a missing security patch in telemetry, then deploy it to a single device or the entire fleet in one click. ASTRA orchestrates the rollout and streams live progress — Pending, Downloading, Installing, Installed — so you always know exactly where every endpoint stands.
bullets: One-click push to a device or whole fleet
Live rollout status for every endpoint
Driven from Telemetry → Updates in the portal
Every push captured in the audit log

assistant.title: Support that speaks human
assistant.desc: Employees just describe the problem. ASTRA recognizes intent, pulls the relevant knowledge, collects telemetry, and walks through the fix — escalating to a person only when a decision truly needs one.

securityHead.title: Enterprise-grade by design
securityHead.subtitle: Least privilege, full auditability and human oversight are foundational — not add-ons.

security.title: JWT + RBAC
security.desc: Short-lived tokens and role-based access on every endpoint.

security.title: Encrypted everywhere
security.desc: Encryption in transit and at rest, HTTPS-only.

security.title: Audit logs
security.desc: Immutable records for all mutations and commands.

faqs.a: Per device, per month. Essential covers inventory, telemetry and patching; Professional adds the AI engine and automatic self-healing; Expert adds compliance, fleet-wide remediation and full audit. Annual billing saves about 17%.

Most teams start on Professional — it's where the AI actually fixes issues on its own. Choose Essential if you mainly need visibility and patching, and Expert if you have compliance or audit requirements.
Yes — start with a free trial, no credit card required to explore the platform.
Absolutely. Upgrade or downgrade at any time; billing adjusts on your next cycle based on your active devices.
Yes. For fleets above 50 devices, contact sales for volume pricing and a guided rollout.

faqs.a: Yes — Technomate is also a laptop and hardware supplier. Bundle devices with ASTRA for a fully managed rollout.
